g.text: Doyle-Fuller-Newman half-cell model of a commercial LiMn₂O₄ cathode in PyBaMM
training RMSE on C/5 and C/2 with three fitted parameters
largest error over six CV peak potentials at three scan rates, never fitted
of the 2C loss: ohmic + contact, charge transfer, particle diffusion
One coin cell, four C-rates, three scan rates · every number regenerated from the raw cycler files
Right: measured discharge curves (solid) and the DFN model (dashed) · open the live page for the 3D half cell
